environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind the same ALB, but the task runs with a read-only root filesystem (readonlyRootFilesystem: true in the ECS task definition). The SQLite database is mounted from an EFS volume at /var/lib/app/ with an EFS access point configured with POSIX permissions uid=1000, gid=1000, permissions=0555 (read+execute only, no write). The container runs as uid=1000. Additionally, the ECS task IAM role has no attached policies (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:role/app-task-role with zero inline or managed policies), and the VPC has no NAT gateway or internet gateway route from the Fargate subnet (isolated subnet with only VPC endpoints for ECR, S3, CloudWatch Logs, and EFS).
